subject: Priority: Dedicated capacity — GPU substitution + temporary reservation hold
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@photonlabs.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@photonlabs.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up on dedicated reservation details

Jonas — thanks for the walkthrough earlier. A few clarifying items from our infra team:

1) We originally scoped A100s but our QA runs show 3x H100 nodes would reduce tail latency for inference by ~40% for our LLM pipelines. Can Redwood support H100s for the Dedicated pool instead of A100?
2) We expect a migration spike for the first 2 weeks after cutover. Can we get a temporary burst window (24/7 burst for first 14 days) and a reservation hold while we complete SW validation?
3) Procurement asks for a single-line SOW and DocuSign link.

Attached our updated SOW template. Happy to chat if helpful — Diego (ops) is copied.

—Elena
Director of Platform, Photon Labs
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, rachel_kim@redwood.example.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-05-01T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up on dedicated reservation details

Laura / Rachel — forwarding Photon Labs request. Key asks: H100 substitution for the reserved pool and a 14-day unlimited burst window plus a reservation hold during validation.

Quick notes:
- Deal size ~ $420k ARR for first-year commit (see HubSpot).
- Customer wants H100 for performance reasons; our standard dedicated SKU for this account is A100.
- Burst is higher cost; they want it without immediate overage charges while they validate.

Can Deal Desk/Finance confirm concession levers here? I think this will be material but short-lived. Proposed internal ask below before looping in Sales leadership:
- Temporary H100 substitution for first 90 days (downgrade back to A100 unless we get long-term commit).
- 14-day waived overage for burst with a one-time reservation hold (no churn of capacity during hold).
- Cap total uplift to no more than 25% of committed monthly spend as a concession.

Please advise whether this needs VP sign-off and cost estimate for the exec.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: rachel_kim@redwood.example.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up on dedicated reservation details

Jonas — ran numbers with finance (see attached burst_pricing_calc_jonas.xlsx). Short summary:
- Temporary swap to H100 for 90 days adds estimated incremental cost of ~$12.5k/month (after internal discounts) based on expected utilization profile.
- 14-day unlimited burst if waived would represent a notional risk exposure of up to $30k depending on peak token throughput; recommend a soft cap trigger (customer pays if >125% of forecast) unless exec approves full waiver.
- Reservation hold (preventing reallocation of those GPUs) reduces our scheduling flexibility; we can accommodate if we ask for a 15% one-time reservation fee to offset opportunity cost or take a short-term discount on list.

I'm marking this as requiring executive exception for: GPU SKU substitution + burst overage waiver + reservation hold fee waiver. If leadership approves, propose the following final concession package to send to Photon Labs:
- 90-day H100 trial at a 10% uplift to their committed rate (instead of A100 pricing).
- 14-day burst included up to 125% of forecasted consumption; above that, standard overage rates apply.
- Reservation hold for 21 days with a one-time reservation hold fee equal to 10% of the month's committed capacity.

If you want me to route to Vivek for approval with an exec memo, I can draft tonight.

—Rachel
Sr. Deal Desk Analyst
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, rachel_kim@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-05-02T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Photon Labs — request for H100 substitution + burst hold (need exec sign-off)

Vivek — brief: Photon Labs (DL-2027-0134) is asking for a temporary H100 substitution and a waived 14-day burst overage while they migrate. Deal Desk (Rachel) recommends an approved exception package (90-day H100 trial, 14-day burst covered up to 125% usage, 21-day reservation hold with 10% fee).

Why this matters:
- High strategic fit: Photon is using Redwood as primary inference vendor across 3 product lines; this expansion could convert into a $1.2M ARR multi-region commitment next year.
- Timing: customer needs the burst window to avoid rollout delays; they will sign SOW only if we grant the temporary H100 profile and the reservation hold.

Requesting your approval on the below ask (pick one):
A) Approve Rachel's recommended package (preferred)
B) Approve full waiver of burst overage for 14 days and a 90-day H100 swap (higher risk; requires revenue protection plan)
C) Deny H100 substitution and offer standard A100 + discounted burst pricing (loss risk to the deal)

Estimated net revenue impact if A) is approved: an incremental concession cost of ~$18k over first quarter but preserves the larger expansion opportunity. I attached the signed SOW draft and the pricing calc.

If you approve A or B, can you reply-all with explicit language we can forward to Photon and legal so we can DocuSign?

Thanks — Jonas
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com, rachel_kim@redwood.example.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-05-03T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Photon Labs — request for H100 substitution + burst hold (need exec sign-off)

Team — after quick review with finance and product: approve option A with one edit. Conditions:
1) Approve 90-day H100 substitution for Photon Labs under the following guardrails: customer signs addendum attaching exact node counts, and we auto-revert to A100 after 90 days unless a 12-month HVAC (expanded commit) is agreed.
2) 14-day burst covered up to 125% of forecasted consumption; notify customer that any sustained >125% usage will trigger a scaled overage and requires immediate engagement with sales for a committed uplift.
3) Reservation hold accepted for 21 days but waive the 10% fee on the condition that Photon's procurement signs the attached exec exception form and agrees to expedited payment terms (Net 30).
4) Cap total one-time concessions to no more than 25% of the first month's committed value.

I approve now. Jonas — please send the customer the updated SOW + DocuSign link and confirm they accept guardrails. Rachel — update HubSpot and flag renewal ops for possible SKU migration.

—Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.example.com
To: Elena Torres <elena@photonlabs.ai>, Procurement <procurement@photonlabs.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com, laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, rachel_kim@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-05-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on dedicated reservation details — approved exception + next steps

Elena / Diego — good news: Redwood can accommodate your request under the approved exception package. Summary of agreed terms (executive-approved):
- 90-day H100 substitution: Redwood will provision the requested H100 nodes for your Dedicated pool for 90 days. After 90 days we will revert to A100 unless both parties agree to a 12-month expanded commit.
- 14-day burst window: Redwood will include a 14-day burst allowance covering up to 125% of forecasted consumption. Any usage above 125% will be billed at standard overage rates and triggers an immediate review.
- Reservation hold: Redwood will hold the reserved capacity for 21 days. The reservation hold fee is waived provided Photon signs the enclosed exec exception form and the SOW and adheres to Net 30 payment terms.

Action items:
1) I've attached the updated SOW (PhotonLabs_SOW_v3.pdf) and the exec exception form. Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123
2) Procurement: please confirm the Node counts you need in the addendum (we need exact SKU quantities to provision).
3) Rachel: I'll loop you on the DocuSign completion to update HubSpot and schedule the provisioning team.

Thanks — Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
